 263→    schema_version: Literal["mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1", "mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1_1"] = PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 264→    dependency_field: ClassVar[str]
 265→    dependency_sha256: Optional[Sha256] = None
 266→
 267→    def _dependency_hash(self, hashes: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
 268→        payload = json.dumps(
 269→            {"domain": "mw_protocol_v3_dependencies_v1", "field": self.dependency_field, "hashes": hashes},
 270→            sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
 271→        )
 272→        return sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 273→
 274→    @model_validator(mode="after")
 275→    def validate_dependency_binding(self) -> Self:
 276→        hashes = getattr(self, self.dependency_field)
 277→        _unique(hashes, self.dependency_field)
 278→        if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 279→            if not hashes or self.dependency_sha256 is not None:
 280→                raise ValueError("legacy contracts require dependency hashes and no compact digest")
 281→        else:
 282→            if self.dependency_sha256 is None:
 283→                raise ValueError("compact contracts require a dependency digest")
 284→            if hashes and self._dependency_hash(hashes) != self.dependency_sha256:
 285→                raise ValueError("dependency hashes do not match compact digest")
 286→            object.__setattr__(self, self.dependency_field, ())
 287→        return self
 288→
 289→    @model_serializer(mode="wrap")
 290→    def serialize_dependency_binding(self, handler):
 291→        payload = handler(self)
 292→        payload.pop(
 293→            "dependency_sha256" if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 294→            else self.dependency_field, None,
 295→        )
 296→        return payload
 297→
 298→    def compact_dependencies(self) -> Self:
 299→        if self.schema_version != PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 300→            return self
 301→        payload = self.model_dump()
 302→        payload.update(
 303→            schema_version="mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1_1",
 304→            dependency_sha256=self._dependency_hash(getattr(self, self.dependency_field)),
 305→        )
 306→        return type(self).model_validate(payload)
 307→
 308→    def matches_dependencies(self, hashes: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
 309→        if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 310→            return hashes == getattr(self, self.dependency_field)
 311→        return self._dependency_hash(hashes) == self.dependency_sha256

 997→        }
 998→        if self.status in terminal_statuses:
 999→            if (
1000→                self.terminal_state is None
1001→                or self.terminal_state.value != self.status.value
1002→            ):
1003→                raise ValueError(
1004→                    "terminal_state must match terminal reservation status"
1005→                )
1006→            if self.provider_session_id is None:

1008→        elif self.terminal_state is not None:
1009→            raise ValueError(

1011→            )
1012→        if self.status is ReservationStatus.COMPLETED:
1013→            if self.output_sha256 is None or self.error_code is not None:
1014→                raise ValueError("completed reservations require output and no error")
1015→        elif self.status in {

1020→                raise ValueError(

1023→        elif self.output_sha256 is not None or self.error_code is not None:

1412→class SubstantiveContentContractV2(StatefulProtocolV3Model):
1413→    schema_version: Literal["mw_protocol_v3_contract_v2"] = (
1414→        CHAPTER_CONTRACT_V2_SCHEMA_VERSION
1415→    )

1426→    @model_validator(mode="after")
1427→    def validate_substantive_obligations_v2(self) -> Self:
1428→        fact_paths = tuple(item.fact_path for item in self.fact_requirements)
1429→        if len(fact_paths) != len(set(fact_paths)):
1430→            raise ValueError(
1431→                "conflicting fact obligations: a fact path cannot carry two "
1432→                "obligation entries"
1433→            )
1434→        claim_types = tuple(item.claim_type for item in self.claim_requirements)
1435→        if len(claim_types) != len(set(claim_types)):
1436→            raise ValueError(
1437→                "conflicting claim obligations: a claim type cannot carry two "
1438→                "obligation entries"
1439→            )
1440→        _unique(self.project_specific_elements, "project_specific_elements")
1441→        _unique(
1442→            tuple(
1443→                item.object_kind.value for item in self.structural_object_obligations
1444→            ),
1445→            "structural_object_obligations",
1446→        )
1447→        forbidden_claims = {
1448→            item.claim_type
1449→            for item in self.claim_requirements
1450→            if item.obligation is ClaimObligation.FORBIDDEN
1451→        }
1452→        for evidence in self.evidence_source_requirements:
1453→            if forbidden_claims & set(evidence.admission_claim_types):
1454→                raise ValueError(
1455→                    "a forbidden claim type cannot be an admission requirement"
1456→                )
1457→        obligations = (
1458→            self.fact_requirements,
1459→            self.claim_requirements,
1460→            self.evidence_source_requirements,
1461→            self.structural_object_obligations,
1462→            self.project_specific_elements,
1463→        )
1464→        if not any(obligations):
1465→            raise ValueError("SubstantiveContentContractV2 is vacuous")
1466→        if (
1467→            self.structural_object_obligations
1468→            and not self.fact_requirements
1469→            and not self.claim_requirements
1470→            and not self.evidence_source_requirements
1471→            and not self.project_specific_elements
1472→        ):
1473→            raise ValueError(
1474→                "object-only content obligations require project-specific "
1475→                "elements instead of generic title/paragraph presence"
1476→            )
1477→        positive = (
1478→            any(item.obligation is FactObligation.REQUIRED for item in self.fact_requirements)
1479→            or any(item.obligation is ClaimObligation.REQUIRED for item in self.claim_requirements)
1480→            or self.evidence_source_requirements
1481→            or self.project_specific_elements
1482→        )
1483→        if not positive:
1484→            raise ValueError("content contract requires a positive substantive obligation")
1485→        return self

1→"""Typed chapter registry core for Protocol v3 Task 3R.3.
   2→
   3→This module is reusable registry infrastructure only.  It loads per-node
   4→registries whose chapters embed the accepted :class:`ChapterContractV2`
   5→payloads together with dedicated chapter-skill manifests, a closed fact/claim
   6→vocabulary and executable positive/negative fixtures.  It deliberately does
   7→NOT author clinical chapter content, call any product, or decide medical or
   8→QC judgment: deterministic findings and unexecuted judgment obligations are
   9→reported separately.
  10→
  11→Compact JSON layout (documented by :func:`load_chapter_registry` and the
  12→round-trip example in ``tests/protocol_v3/test_all_chapter_contracts.py``)::
  13→
  14→    {
  15→      "schema_version": "protocol-v3-chapter-registry.v1",
  16→      "generated_for": "...", "authority": "...",
  17→      "template_id": "tp_ma_07_v2",
  18→      "template_sha256": "<frozen source sha256 of the accepted template>",
  19→      "fact_vocabulary":  ["picos.objective.primary", ...],
  20→      "claim_vocabulary": ["study_objective", ...],
  21→      "chapters": [
  22→        {"node_id": "v2_n_3_1_1",
  23→         "coverage_role": "heading_leaf",
  24→         "contract":   { ...ChapterContractV2 payload, embedded verbatim... },
  25→         "skills":     [ { ...ChapterSkillManifest payload... } ]},
  26→        ...
  27→      ],
  28→      "fixtures": [
  29→        {"fixture_id": "fixture:objectives:positive",
  30→         "chapter_contract_id": "contract:v2-n-3-1-1:v2",
  31→         "fixture_kind": "positive",
  32→         "content": {"facts": [...], "claims": [...],
  33→                      "evidence": [...], "objects": [...]},
  34→         "supplied_passed": null, "supplied_qc_verdict": null}
  35→      ]
  36→    }
  37→
  38→``coverage_role`` is one of ``heading_leaf`` (leaf in both the heading-style
  39→tree and the outlined tree), ``heading_only_aggregation`` (heading-tree-only
  40→leaf such as the TP-MA-07 appendix container: aggregation/Word obligations,
  41→not a content leaf), ``outline_only_leaf`` (glossary / concrete appendix
  42→leaves), or ``cover`` (the unheaded front-block carrier).  Coverage truth is
  43→always derived from the template ``node_tree.json`` at lint time; counts are
  44→never hardcoded.
  45→
  46→The chapter-skill manifests carry no model transport fields: provider/model
  47→choice belongs to the approved role binding (``role_registry.json``), not to
  48→an individual skill.  The skill I/O schemas are the concrete exported
  49→Pydantic types :class:`ChapterSkillInput` and :class:`ChapterSkillOutput`;
  50→manifest schema refs must name exactly those types.
  51→"""

 306→def resolve_schema_ref(ref: str) -> type[BaseModel]:
 307→    """Resolve a ``module:TypeName`` schema ref to the exported Pydantic type."""
 308→    module_name, _, type_name = ref.partition(":")
 309→    if not module_name or not type_name:
 310→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"malformed schema ref: {ref!r}")
 311→    try:
 312→        module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
 313→        resolved = getattr(module, type_name)
 314→    except (ImportError, AttributeError) as exc:
 315→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"schema ref does not resolve: {ref!r}") from exc
 316→    if not (isinstance(resolved, type) and issubclass(resolved, BaseModel)):
 317→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"schema ref is not a Pydantic model: {ref!r}")
 318→    return resolved

 446→class ChapterRegistryDocument(BaseModel):
 447→    """Closed, versioned chapter registry document."""
 448→
 449→    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True, str_strip_whitespace=True)
 450→
 451→    schema_version: Literal[CHAPTER_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION]  # type: ignore[valid-type]
 452→    generated_for: NonEmptyText
 453→    authority: NonEmptyText
 454→    template_id: StableId
 455→    template_sha256: Sha256
 456→    fact_vocabulary: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 457→    claim_vocabulary: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 458→    chapters: tuple[ChapterEntry, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 459→    fixtures: tuple[ChapterFixture, ...] = ()
 460→
 461→    @field_validator("fact_vocabulary", "claim_vocabulary")
 462→    @classmethod
 463→    def _vocab_closed(
 464→        cls, value: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...], info: Any
 465→    ) -> tuple[NonEmptyText, ...]:
 466→        if len(value) != len(set(value)):
 467→            raise ValueError(f"{info.field_name} must not contain duplicates")
 468→        return value
 469→
 470→    @model_validator(mode="after")
 471→    def _cross_document_identity(self) -> ChapterRegistryDocument:
 472→        node_ids = [entry.node_id for entry in self.chapters]
 473→        if len(node_ids) != len(set(node_ids)):
 474→            duplicates = sorted({nid for nid in node_ids if node_ids.count(nid) > 1})
 475→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate chapter node ids: {duplicates}")
 476→        contract_ids = [entry.contract.chapter_contract_id for entry in self.chapters]
 477→        if len(contract_ids) != len(set(contract_ids)):
 478→            duplicates = sorted({cid for cid in contract_ids if contract_ids.count(cid) > 1})
 479→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate chapter contract ids: {duplicates}")
 480→        skill_ids = [
 481→            skill.skill_id for entry in self.chapters for skill in entry.skills
 482→        ]
 483→        if len(skill_ids) != len(set(skill_ids)):
 484→            duplicates = sorted({sid for sid in skill_ids if skill_ids.count(sid) > 1})
 485→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate skill ids: {duplicates}")
 486→        for entry in self.chapters:
 487→            if entry.contract.template_id != self.template_id:
 488→                raise ValueError(
 489→                    f"chapter {entry.node_id!r} template_id differs from the registry"
 490→                )
 491→            if entry.contract.template_sha256 != self.template_sha256:
 492→                raise ValueError(
 493→                    f"chapter {entry.node_id!r} template_sha256 differs from the registry"
 494→                )
 495→        fixture_ids = [fixture.fixture_id for fixture in self.fixtures]
 496→        if len(fixture_ids) != len(set(fixture_ids)):
 497→            duplicates = sorted({fid for fid in fixture_ids if fixture_ids.count(fid) > 1})
 498→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate fixture ids: {duplicates}")
 499→        declared = set(contract_ids)
 500→        for fixture in self.fixtures:
 501→            if fixture.chapter_contract_id not in declared:
 502→                raise ValueError(
 503→                    f"fixture {fixture.fixture_id!r} binds unknown chapter contract "
 504→                    f"{fixture.chapter_contract_id!r}"
 505→                )
 506→        return self

 509→def _load_json(source: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 510→    if isinstance(source, Mapping):
 511→        return json.loads(json.dumps(dict(source), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
 512→    path = Path(source)
 513→    try:
 514→        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 515→    except OSError as exc:
 516→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"chapter registry unreadable: {path}") from exc
 517→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
 518→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"chapter registry is not valid JSON: {path}") from exc
 519→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
 520→        raise ChapterRegistryError(
 521→            f"chapter registry must be a JSON object; got {type(data).__name__}"
 522→        )
 523→    return data

 526→def load_chapter_registry(
 527→    source: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any],
 528→) -> ChapterRegistryDocument:
 529→    """Load and validate a chapter registry document fail-closed.
 530→
 531→    Raises :class:`ChapterRegistryError` (a ``ValueError``) for any closed-set,
 532→    schema-version, duplicate, identity-binding or vocabulary violation.
 533→    """
 534→    data = _load_json(source)
 535→    _scan_credentials(data, "chapter-registry")
 536→    try:
 537→        document = ChapterRegistryDocument.model_validate(data)
 538→    except ValidationError as exc:
 539→        raise ChapterRegistryError(
 540→            f"chapter registry failed closed: {exc}"
 541→        ) from exc
 542→    return document

 591→def evaluate_chapter_content(
 592→    contract: ChapterContractV2,
 593→    content: ChapterContentPayload,
 594→    *,
 595→    subject_id: str,
 596→    supplied_passed: Optional[bool] = None,
 597→    supplied_qc_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
 598→) -> FixtureCheckResult:
 599→    """Deterministically check supplied content against a chapter contract.
 600→
 601→    Only shape/positivity/source-floor violations are decided here.  Positive
 602→    QC rules, CtQ items and skeleton-risk rules that require medical judgment
 603→    are returned as ``deferred_qc_obligations`` and are never counted as
 604→    evaluated.  Supplied ``passed`` flags and QC verdict strings are ignored.
 605→    """
 606→    findings: list[CheckerFinding] = []
 607→    substantive = contract.substantive_content
 608→
 609→    facts_by_path = {fact.fact_path: fact for fact in content.facts}
 610→    claims_by_type = {claim.claim_type: claim for claim in content.claims}
 611→
 612→    for index, requirement in enumerate(substantive.fact_requirements):
 613→        location = f"contract.fact_requirements[{index}]({requirement.fact_path})"
 614→        supplied = facts_by_path.get(requirement.fact_path)
 615→        has_value = supplied is not None and bool((supplied.value or "").strip())
 616→        if requirement.obligation.value == "required" and not has_value:
 617→            findings.append(
 618→                _finding(
 619→                    "missing_required_fact",
 620→                    location,
 621→                    "required fact is absent, null or blank; key existence alone "
 622→                    "is insufficient",
 623→                )
 624→            )
 625→        if requirement.obligation.value == "forbidden" and has_value:
 626→            findings.append(
 627→                _finding(
 628→                    "forbidden_fact_present",
 629→                    location,
 630→                    "forbidden fact path carries actual content",
 631→                )
 632→            )
 633→
 634→    for index, requirement in enumerate(substantive.claim_requirements):
 635→        location = f"contract.claim_requirements[{index}]({requirement.claim_type})"
 636→        supplied = claims_by_type.get(requirement.claim_type)
 637→        has_statement = supplied is not None and bool(
 638→            (supplied.statement or "").strip()
 639→        )
 640→        if requirement.obligation.value == "required" and not has_statement:
 641→            findings.append(
 642→                _finding(
 643→                    "missing_required_claim",
 644→                    location,
 645→                    "required claim is absent or its statement is empty",
 646→                )
 647→            )
 648→        if requirement.obligation.value == "forbidden" and has_statement:
 649→            findings.append(
 650→                _finding(
 651→                    "forbidden_claim_present",
 652→                    location,
 653→                    "forbidden claim type carries an actual statement",
 654→                )
 655→            )
 656→        if requirement.obligation.value == "qualified" and has_statement:
 657→            findings.append(
 658→                CheckerFinding(
 659→                    code="qualified_claim_needs_review",
 660→                    severity="info",
 661→                    location=location,
 662→                    message=(
 663→                        "qualified claim present; qualifying conditions require "
 664→                        "medical judgment not executed here"
 665→                    ),
 666→                )
 667→            )
 668→
 669→    requirements = substantive.evidence_source_requirements
 670→    for group_index, group in enumerate(requirements):
 671→        group_location = f"contract.evidence_source_requirements[{group_index}]"
 672→        roles = {role.value for role in group.source_roles}
 673→        admissions = set(group.admission_claim_types)
 674→        locators = {kind.value for kind in group.allowed_locator_kinds}
 675→        conforming = False
 676→        for item_index, item in enumerate(content.evidence):
 677→            item_location = f"{group_location}.supplied[{item_index}]"
 678→            if item.admission_claim_type not in admissions:
 679→                continue
 680→            if item.source_role.value not in roles and any(
 681→                item.source_role in other.source_roles
 682→                and item.admission_claim_type in other.admission_claim_types
 683→                for other in requirements
 684→            ):
 685→                continue
 686→            if item.admission_claim_type in admissions and item.source_role.value not in roles:
 687→                findings.append(
 688→                    _finding(
 689→                        "wrong_source_role",
 690→                        item_location,
 691→                        f"source role {item.source_role.value!r} may not admit "
 692→                        f"claim {item.admission_claim_type!r}",
 693→                    )
 694→                )
 695→            if item.locator_kind.value not in locators:
 696→                findings.append(
 697→                    _finding(
 698→                        "disallowed_locator",
 699→                        item_location,
 700→                        f"locator kind {item.locator_kind.value!r} is not allowed",
 701→                    )
 702→                )
 703→            if group.require_context_window and not (item.context or "").strip():
 704→                findings.append(
 705→                    _finding(
 706→                        "missing_context_window",
 707→                        item_location,
 708→                        "evidence floor requires a non-blank context window",
 709→                    )
 710→                )
 711→            if item.quality_score < group.minimum_quality_score:
 712→                findings.append(
 713→                    _finding(
 714→                        "insufficient_quality",
 715→                        item_location,
 716→                        f"quality score {item.quality_score} is below the floor "
 717→                        f"{group.minimum_quality_score}",
 718→                    )
 719→                )
 720→            if (
 721→                item.source_role.value in roles
 722→                and item.admission_claim_type in admissions
 723→                and item.locator_kind.value in locators
 724→                and (not group.require_context_window or (item.context or "").strip())
 725→                and item.quality_score >= group.minimum_quality_score
 726→            ):
 727→                conforming = True
 728→        if not conforming:
 729→            findings.append(
 730→                _finding(
 731→                    "unsatisfied_evidence_requirement",
 732→                    group_location,
 733→                    "no supplied evidence unit satisfies this evidence floor",
 734→                )
 735→            )
 736→    if requirements:
 737→        declared_admissions = {
 738→            claim for group in requirements for claim in group.admission_claim_types
 739→        }
 740→        declared_roles = {
 741→            role.value for group in requirements for role in group.source_roles
 742→        }
 743→        for item_index, item in enumerate(content.evidence):
 744→            if item.admission_claim_type not in declared_admissions and item.source_role.value in declared_roles:
 745→                findings.append(_finding(
 746→                    "inadmissible_claim", f"content.evidence[{item_index}]",
 747→                    "claim is not admitted by any declared evidence requirement",
 748→                ))
 749→            if (
 750→                item.admission_claim_type not in declared_admissions
 751→                and item.source_role.value not in declared_roles
 752→            ):
 753→                findings.append(
 754→                    CheckerFinding(
 755→                        code="undeclared_evidence_source",
 756→                        severity="warning",
 757→                        location=f"content.evidence[{item_index}]",
 758→                        message="evidence unit maps to no declared evidence floor",
 759→                    )
 760→                )
 761→
 762→    for index, obligation in enumerate(substantive.structural_object_obligations):
 763→        location = (
 764→            f"contract.structural_object_obligations[{index}]"
 765→            f"({obligation.object_kind.value})"
 766→        )
 767→        material = _material_occurrences(content, obligation.object_kind.value)
 768→        if material < obligation.minimum_occurrences:
 769→            findings.append(
 770→                _finding(
 771→                    "missing_structural_object",
 772→                    location,
 773→                    f"material occurrences {material} are below the required "
 774→                    f"{obligation.minimum_occurrences}; ID-only shells do not count",
 775→                )
 776→            )
 777→        supplied_cells = {
 778→            cell.cell_id: cell
 779→            for obj in content.objects
 780→            if obj.object_kind.value == obligation.object_kind.value
 781→            for cell in obj.cells
 782→        }
 783→        for cell_id in obligation.required_object_cells:
 784→            cell = supplied_cells.get(cell_id)
 785→            if cell is None or not (cell.value or "").strip():
 786→                findings.append(
 787→                    _finding(
 788→                        "missing_required_cell",
 789→                        f"{location}.cell({cell_id})",
 790→                        "required cell is absent, null or blank",
 791→                    )
 792→                )
 793→
 794→    required_fact_paths = {
 795→        item.fact_path
 796→        for item in substantive.fact_requirements
 797→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 798→    }
 799→    required_claim_types = {
 800→        item.claim_type
 801→        for item in substantive.claim_requirements
 802→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 803→    }
 804→    has_any_positive_content = (
 805→        any(
 806→            (fact.value or "").strip()
 807→            for fact in content.facts
 808→            if fact.fact_path in required_fact_paths
 809→        )
 810→        or any(
 811→            (claim.statement or "").strip()
 812→            for claim in content.claims
 813→            if claim.claim_type in required_claim_types
 814→        )
 815→        or any(obj.is_material() for obj in content.objects)
 816→    )
 817→    if not has_any_positive_content:
 818→        findings.append(
 819→            _finding(
 820→                "skeleton_content",
 821→                "content",
 822→                "no required fact value, claim statement or material object is "
 823→                "present; title/skeleton-only output fails",
 824→            )
 825→        )
 826→
 827→    known_fact_paths = {item.fact_path for item in substantive.fact_requirements}
 828→    known_claim_types = {item.claim_type for item in substantive.claim_requirements}
 829→    for index, fact in enumerate(content.facts):
 830→        if fact.fact_path not in known_fact_paths:
 831→            findings.append(
 832→                CheckerFinding(
 833→                    code="undeclared_fact_path",
 834→                    severity="warning",
 835→                    location=f"content.facts[{index}]({fact.fact_path})",
 836→                    message="fact path is not declared by this chapter contract",
 837→                )
 838→            )
 839→    for index, claim in enumerate(content.claims):
 840→        if claim.claim_type not in known_claim_types:
 841→            findings.append(
 842→                CheckerFinding(
 843→                    code="undeclared_claim_type",
 844→                    severity="warning",
 845→                    location=f"content.claims[{index}]({claim.claim_type})",
 846→                    message="claim type is not declared by this chapter contract",
 847→                )
 848→            )
 849→
 850→    deferred: list[str] = ["medical_and_qc_judgment_not_executed"]
 851→    for rule in contract.positive_qc_rules:
 852→        deferred.append(f"positive_qc_rule:{rule.positive_qc_rule_id}: {rule.rule}")
 853→    for item in contract.ctq_items:
 854→        deferred.append(f"ctq:{item.ctq_item_id}: {item.question}")
 855→    for rule in substantive.skeleton_risk_rules:
 856→        deferred.append(f"skeleton_risk_rule: {rule}")
 857→    for rule in contract.conditional_applicability_rules:
 858→        deferred.append(f"conditional_applicability_not_executed:{rule.conditional_applicability_rule_id}")
 859→    for element in substantive.project_specific_elements:
 860→        deferred.append(f"project_specific_element_not_evaluated: {element}")
 861→
 862→    ignored = supplied_passed is not None or supplied_qc_verdict is not None
 863→    return FixtureCheckResult(
 864→        subject_id=subject_id,
 865→        chapter_contract_id=contract.chapter_contract_id,
 866→        passed=not any(f.severity == "error" for f in findings),
 867→        findings=tuple(findings),
 868→        deferred_qc_obligations=tuple(deferred),
 869→        ignored_supplied_verdict=ignored,
 870→    )

 928→def _fixture_matches(contract: ChapterContractV2, fixture: ChapterFixture,
 929→                     result: FixtureCheckResult) -> bool:
 930→    if fixture.fixture_kind == "positive":
 931→        return result.passed
 932→    substantive = contract.substantive_content
 933→    missing: set[str] = set()
 934→    if any(item.obligation.value == "required" for item in substantive.fact_requirements):
 935→        missing.add("missing_required_fact")
 936→    if any(item.obligation.value == "required" for item in substantive.claim_requirements):
 937→        missing.add("missing_required_claim")
 938→    if substantive.evidence_source_requirements:
 939→        missing.add("unsatisfied_evidence_requirement")
 940→    if substantive.structural_object_obligations:
 941→        missing.add("missing_structural_object")
 942→    if any(item.required_object_cells for item in substantive.structural_object_obligations):
 943→        missing.add("missing_required_cell")
 944→    expected = {
 945→        "missing_claim": missing & {"missing_required_claim"},
 946→        "missing_control": missing,
 947→        "wrong_source": {"wrong_source_role", "inadmissible_claim", "disallowed_locator",
 948→                         "missing_context_window", "insufficient_quality"},
 949→        "skeleton": {"skeleton_content", "missing_structural_object", "missing_required_cell"},
 950→    }[fixture.fixture_kind]
 951→    return not result.passed and bool(set(result.error_codes()) & expected)

 996→def _expected_roles_from_template(
 997→    node_tree: Mapping[str, Any],
 998→) -> tuple[dict[str, str], bool]:
 999→    heading_nodes = (node_tree.get("heading_style_tree") or {}).get("nodes") or []
1000→    outlined_nodes = (node_tree.get("outlined_tree") or {}).get("nodes") or []
1001→    heading_leaves = {
1002→        node["id"] for node in heading_nodes if node.get("is_leaf_heading")
1003→    }
1004→    outline_leaves = {node["id"] for node in outlined_nodes if node.get("is_leaf")}
1005→    roles: dict[str, str] = {}
1006→    for node_id in heading_leaves | outline_leaves:
1007→        in_heading = node_id in heading_leaves
1008→        in_outline = node_id in outline_leaves
1009→        if in_heading and in_outline:
1010→            roles[node_id] = "heading_leaf"
1011→        elif in_heading:
1012→            roles[node_id] = "heading_only_aggregation"
1013→        else:
1014→            roles[node_id] = "outline_only_leaf"
1015→    has_front_block = bool(node_tree.get("front_block"))
1016→    return roles, has_front_block
1017→

1019→def _load_template_inputs(template_dir: str | Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
1020→    directory = Path(template_dir)
1021→    node_tree_path = directory / "node_tree.json"
1022→    template_path = directory / "template.json"
1023→    try:
1024→        node_tree = json.loads(node_tree_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1025→        template = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1026→    except OSError as exc:
1027→        raise LintInputError(
1028→            f"template directory must contain readable node_tree.json and "
1029→            f"template.json: {directory}"
1030→        ) from exc
1031→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
1032→        raise LintInputError(f"template input is not valid JSON: {directory}") from exc
1033→    source = template.get("source") or {}
1034→    if not template.get("template_id") or not source.get("sha256"):
1035→        raise LintInputError(
1036→            f"template.json must declare template_id and source.sha256: {template_path}"
1037→        )
1038→    return node_tree, template
1039→
1040→
1041→def lint_registry(
1042→    template_dir: str | Path,
1043→    registry: ChapterRegistryDocument,
1044→    *,
1045→    require_complete: bool = True,
1046→) -> LintReport:
1047→    """Cross-contract lint of a chapter registry against the template.
1048→
1049→    Coverage truth derives from the template ``node_tree.json``: the union of
1050→    heading-tree ``is_leaf_heading`` and outlined-tree ``is_leaf`` leaves plus
1051→    the explicit unheaded cover carrier.  Counts are computed, never
1052→    hardcoded, and ``is_leaf`` on heading-only nodes is never used as
1053→    coverage.
1054→
1055→    Full mode (``require_complete=True``) reports every coverage gap as an
1056→    error.  Partial mode validates the submitted batch but always reports the
1057→    registry incomplete and never represents full acceptance: its status is
1058→    ``"incomplete"`` by construction.
1059→    """
1060→    node_tree, template = _load_template_inputs(template_dir)
1061→    expected_roles, has_front_block = _expected_roles_from_template(node_tree)
1062→    template_id = str(template["template_id"])
1063→    template_sha = str(template["source"]["sha256"])
1064→    mapping_path = Path(template_dir) / "v1_to_v2_mapping.json"
1065→    expected_cover_id = None
1066→    if mapping_path.exists():
1067→        try:
1068→            mapping = json.loads(mapping_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1069→            cover_ids = {
1070→                node for row in mapping["forward_mapping"]
1071→                if row.get("semantic_node_id") == "document_control.front_matter"
1072→                for node in row["target_v2_node_ids"]
1073→            }
1074→        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
1075→            raise LintInputError("cannot resolve cover identity from template mapping") from exc
1076→        if len(cover_ids) != 1:
1077→            raise LintInputError("template mapping must identify one front-matter carrier")
1078→        expected_cover_id = next(iter(cover_ids))
1079→
1080→    findings: list[LintFinding] = []
1081→
1082→    def add(code: str, severity: str, location: str, message: str, node_id: str | None = None) -> None:
1083→        findings.append(
1084→            LintFinding(
1085→                code=code,
1086→                severity=severity,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
1087→                node_id=node_id,
1088→                location=location,
1089→                message=message,
1090→            )
1091→        )
1092→
1093→    # --- template identity -------------------------------------------------
1094→    if registry.template_id != template_id:
1095→        add(
1096→            "template_id_mismatch",
1097→            "error",
1098→            "registry.template_id",
1099→            f"registry binds {registry.template_id!r} but the template dir "
1100→            f"declares {template_id!r}",
1101→        )
1102→    if registry.template_sha256 != template_sha:
1103→        add(
1104→            "template_hash_mismatch",
1105→            "error",
1106→            "registry.template_sha256",
1107→            "registry template hash differs from the frozen template source hash",
1108→        )
1109→
1110→    covered: dict[str, str] = {}
1111→    declared_contract_ids: set[str] = set()
1112→    cover_entries: list[ChapterEntry] = []
1113→    for entry in registry.chapters:
1114→        node_id = entry.node_id
1115→        contract = entry.contract
1116→        declared_contract_ids.add(contract.chapter_contract_id)
1117→        if entry.coverage_role == "cover":
1118→            cover_entries.append(entry)
1119→            if expected_cover_id and node_id != expected_cover_id:
1120→                add("cover_identity_mismatch", "error", f"chapters[{node_id}].node_id",
1121→                    f"accepted mapping identifies cover {expected_cover_id!r}", node_id)
1122→            if node_id in expected_roles:
1123→                add(
1124→                    "unexpected_carrier",
1125→                    "error",
1126→                    f"chapters[{node_id}].coverage_role",
1127→                    "the cover carrier must be the unheaded front block, not a "
1128→                    "node from the leaf union",
1129→                    node_id,
1130→                )
1131→            covered.setdefault(node_id, "cover")
1132→        if node_id not in expected_roles and entry.coverage_role != "cover":
1133→            add(
1134→                "unexpected_carrier",
1135→                "error",
1136→                f"chapters[{node_id}].node_id",
1137→                "carrier is not in the derived leaf union; mid-tree headings "
1138→                "are not coverage",
1139→                node_id,
1140→            )
1141→            continue
1142→        expected_role = expected_roles.get(node_id, "cover")
1143→        if entry.coverage_role != expected_role:
1144→            add(
1145→                "coverage_role_mismatch",
1146→                "error",
1147→                f"chapters[{node_id}].coverage_role",
1148→                f"declared role {entry.coverage_role!r} contradicts the derived "
1149→                f"role {expected_role!r}",
1150→                node_id,
1151→            )
1152→        covered.setdefault(node_id, entry.coverage_role)
1153→
1154→        if contract.template_id != template_id:
1155→            add(
1156→                "template_id_mismatch",
1157→                "error",
1158→                f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.template_id",
1159→                f"contract binds {contract.template_id!r}, expected {template_id!r}",
1160→                node_id,
1161→            )
1162→        if contract.template_sha256 != template_sha:
1163→            add(
1164→                "template_hash_mismatch",
1165→                "error",
1166→                f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.template_sha256",
1167→                "contract template hash differs from the frozen template source hash",
1168→                node_id,
1169→            )
1170→
1171→        bound_skill_ids = {skill.skill_id for skill in entry.skills}
1172→        if contract.chapter_skill_id not in bound_skill_ids:
1173→            add(
1174→                "skill_not_bound",
1175→                "error",
1176→                f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.chapter_skill_id",
1177→                f"contract declares skill {contract.chapter_skill_id!r} but no "
1178→                f"companion manifest provides it",
1179→                node_id,
1180→            )
1181→        for skill in entry.skills:
1182→            if skill.skill_id == contract.chapter_skill_id and skill.skill_version != contract.chapter_skill_version:
1183→                add("skill_version_mismatch", "error",
1184→                    f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.chapter_skill_version",
1185→                    "companion skill version differs from the declared contract version", node_id)
1186→
1187→        # --- closed vocabulary -------------------------------------------------
1188→        substantive = contract.substantive_content
1189→        declared_fact_paths = {item.fact_path for item in substantive.fact_requirements}
1190→        conditional_fact_paths = {
1191→            path
1192→            for rule in contract.conditional_applicability_rules
1193→            for path in (*rule.triggering_fact_paths, *rule.required_when_active_fact_paths)
1194→        }
1195→        ctq_fact_paths = {
1196→            path for item in contract.ctq_items for path in item.linked_fact_paths
1197→        }
1198→        registry_fact_paths = {
1199→            path
1200→            for obligation in contract.registry_consistency_obligations
1201→            for path in obligation.eligibility_fact_paths
1202→        }
1203→        used_fact_paths = (
1204→            declared_fact_paths | conditional_fact_paths | ctq_fact_paths | registry_fact_paths
1205→        )
1206→        for path in sorted(used_fact_paths - set(registry.fact_vocabulary)):
1207→            add(
1208→                "unknown_fact_path",
1209→                "error",
1210→                f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.fact_paths({path})",
1211→                "fact path is not a member of the registry fact vocabulary",
1212→                node_id,
1213→            )
1214→        declared_claim_types = {
1215→            item.claim_type for item in substantive.claim_requirements
1216→        }
1217→        conditional_claim_types = {
1218→            claim for rule in contract.conditional_applicability_rules
1219→            for claim in rule.required_when_active_claim_types
1220→        }
1221→        evidence_claim_types = {
1222→            claim for requirement in substantive.evidence_source_requirements
1223→            for claim in requirement.admission_claim_types
1224→        }
1225→        ctq_claim_types = {
1226→            claim for item in contract.ctq_items for claim in item.linked_claim_types
1227→        }
1228→        for claim in sorted((declared_claim_types | ctq_claim_types | conditional_claim_types | evidence_claim_types) - set(registry.claim_vocabulary)):
1229→            add(
1230→                "unknown_claim_type",
1231→                "error",
1232→                f"chapters[{node_id}].contract.claim_types({claim})",
1233→                "claim type is not a member of the registry claim vocabulary",
1234→                node_id,
1235→            )
1236→
1237→        # --- conditional required vs forbidden contradictions ------------------
1238→        forbidden_fact_paths = {
1239→            item.fact_path
1240→            for item in substantive.fact_requirements
1241→            if item.obligation.value == "forbidden"
1242→        }
1243→        forbidden_claim_types = {
1244→            item.claim_type
1245→            for item in substantive.claim_requirements
1246→            if item.obligation.value == "forbidden"
1247→        }
1248→        for rule in contract.conditional_applicability_rules:
1249→            rule_location = (
1250→                f"chapters[{node_id}].conditional_applicability_rules"
1251→                f"({rule.conditional_applicability_rule_id})"
1252→            )
1253→            for path in sorted(set(rule.required_when_active_fact_paths) & forbidden_fact_paths):
1254→                add(
1255→                    "conditional_forbidden_conflict",
1256→                    "error",
1257→                    rule_location,
1258→                    f"rule requires fact {path!r} when active, but the contract "
1259→                    f"forbids it",
1260→                    node_id,
1261→                )
1262→            for claim in sorted(
1263→                set(rule.required_when_active_claim_types) & forbidden_claim_types
1264→            ):
1265→                add(
1266→                    "conditional_forbidden_conflict",
1267→                    "error",
1268→                    rule_location,
1269→                    f"rule requires claim {claim!r} when active, but the contract "
1270→                    f"forbids it",
1271→                    node_id,
1272→                )
1273→            for path in sorted(set(rule.triggering_fact_paths) & forbidden_fact_paths):
1274→                add(
1275→                    "conditional_forbidden_conflict",
1276→                    "error",
1277→                    rule_location,
1278→                    f"rule triggers on forbidden fact {path!r}",
1279→                    node_id,
1280→                )
1281→
1282→        # --- CtQ anchors --------------------------------------------------------
1283→        anchorable_facts = declared_fact_paths | conditional_fact_paths
1284→        anchorable_claims = declared_claim_types | conditional_claim_types
1285→        for item in contract.ctq_items:
1286→            for path in sorted(set(item.linked_fact_paths) - anchorable_facts):
1287→                add(
1288→                    "dangling_ctq_anchor",
1289→                    "error",
1290→                    f"chapters[{node_id}].ctq_items({item.ctq_item_id})",
1291→                    f"CtQ item anchors unknown fact path {path!r}",
1292→                    node_id,
1293→                )
1294→            for claim in sorted(set(item.linked_claim_types) - anchorable_claims):
1295→                add(
1296→                    "dangling_ctq_anchor",
1297→                    "error",
1298→                    f"chapters[{node_id}].ctq_items({item.ctq_item_id})",
1299→                    f"CtQ item anchors unknown claim type {claim!r}",
1300→                    node_id,
1301→                )
1302→
1303→    # --- dependency resolution ---------------------------------------------
1304→    for entry in registry.chapters:
1305→        for dependency_id in entry.contract.dependency_ids:
1306→            if dependency_id not in declared_contract_ids:
1307→                severity = "error" if require_complete else "warning"
1308→                add(
1309→                    "dangling_dependency",
1310→                    severity,
1311→                    f"chapters[{entry.node_id}].contract.dependency_ids",
1312→                    f"dependency {dependency_id!r} is not declared by any "
1313→                    f"chapter in this registry",
1314→                    entry.node_id,
1315→                )
1316→
1317→    # --- coverage ------------------------------------------------------------
1318→    leaf_union = set(expected_roles)
1319→    cover_node_id = cover_entries[0].node_id if cover_entries else None
1320→    if len(cover_entries) > 1:
1321→        add(
1322→            "duplicate_cover_carrier",
1323→            "error",
1324→            "chapters.coverage_role",
1325→            f"multiple cover carriers declared: "
1326→            f"{sorted(entry.node_id for entry in cover_entries)}",
1327→        )
1328→    if require_complete:
1329→        if not cover_entries:
1330→            add(
1331→                "missing_cover_carrier",
1332→                "error",
1333→                "chapters.coverage_role",
1334→                "the unheaded cover carrier is missing; the leaf union alone is "
1335→                "not full coverage",
1336→            )
1337→        elif not has_front_block:
1338→            add(
1339→                "missing_template_front_block",
1340→                "error",
1341→                "template.node_tree.front_block",
1342→                "registry declares a cover carrier but the template node tree "
1343→                "has no front block",
1344→            )
1345→    expected_cover = expected_cover_id or cover_node_id
1346→    missing_ids = sorted((leaf_union | ({expected_cover} if expected_cover else set())) - set(covered))
1347→    if require_complete:
1348→        for node_id in missing_ids:
1349→            add(
1350→                "missing_coverage",
1351→                "error",
1352→                f"chapters({node_id})",
1353→                "expected carrier has no chapter entry; full mode does not "
1354→                "generate missing chapter data",
1355→                node_id,
1356→            )
1357→    excluded = leaf_union | ({expected_cover} if expected_cover else set())
1358→    unexpected_ids = sorted(set(covered) - excluded)
1359→
1360→    heading_leaf_count = sum(1 for role in expected_roles.values() if role == "heading_leaf")
1361→    aggregation_count = sum(
1362→        1 for role in expected_roles.values() if role == "heading_only_aggregation"
1363→    )
1364→    outline_only_count = sum(
1365→        1 for role in expected_roles.values() if role == "outline_only_leaf"
1366→    )
1367→    expected_carrier_count = len(leaf_union) + 1
1368→    expected_set = excluded
1369→    coverage = CoverageSummary(
